web_evidence.title: Excerpt from For One More Day
web_evidence.note: The author's authorized Hyperion excerpt contains sustained interior scene narration by Chick as I, including his return home and encounter with his mother.

web_evidence.title: For One More Day Educator's Guide
web_evidence.note: The author-hosted guide explicitly identifies two narrators: Maria in the prologue and epilogue and Charley as the main narrator; it describes Charley as telling the story and his memories.

web_evidence.title: For One More Day sample — Sphere / Little, Brown Book Group
web_evidence.note: The publisher-formatted sample gives sustained first-person narration by the frame writer, says the following narrative is assembled in Chick's voice, and then begins Chick's first-person account.

person_note: The controlling narrative is first person. Chick narrates the main story as a participating I, corroborated by four diagnostic event quotes and an authorized interior excerpt. Maria supplies a separate first-person frame in the prologue and epilogue; because both narrators use first person, this is multiple first-person narration rather than ALTERNATING. The dialogue, aphorisms, and generic-you statements were treated as non-base or unmarked rather than evidence of second person. The accessible opening sample does not include the full epilogue, but the author-hosted whole-book guide identifies Maria as its narrator, and no credible contrary evidence was found.
